mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_field (id, api_id, database_name, table_name, field_name, alias, data_type, is_primary, is_required, description) VALUES (#{id}, #{apiId}, #{databaseName}, #{tableName}, #{fieldName}, #{alias}, #{dataType}, #{isPrimary}, #{isRequired}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_field SET api_id = #{apiId}, database_name = #{databaseName}, table_name = #{tableName}, field_name = #{fieldName}, alias = #{alias}, data_type = #{dataType}, is_primary = #{isPrimary}, is_required = #{isRequired}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
